name: EU/EEA/Swiss Citizen Free Movement

requirements.blocker_text: Citizens of EU/EEA member states and Switzerland may live, work, and study in Lithuania without a visa or work permit, under EU free-movement law, registering their residence with the Migration Department after 3 months.

evidence_required.document: Valid EU/EEA/Swiss passport or national ID card
Registration of residence with the Migration Department (after 3 months)
